messages:
niya_partnerships: Quick note: we should standardize partner SEV handoffs for marketplace/hardware launches. current flow is scattershot.
ash_sre: +1. suggestion: single shared channel, 5m private watch, escalate to bridge if not resolved. avoid @here.
dmitri_prod: Minimal flow: 1) channel #partner-<org>-launch 2) 5m watch for liaison 3) 10m create bridge and page oncall 4) assign Redwood owner and record.
alpha_partner: From partner side we need clear consent for log access and a way to upload diagnostic artifacts securely.
niya_partnerships: agree. add a fallback if partner cannot join bridge: Redwood liaison collects artifacts and we do async triage; record notes in the channel.
ash_sre: automation idea: bridge template that auto-invites partner-liaison, primary-oncall, product-SE.  also auto-label case in console as partner-escalation.
dmitri_prod: include SI integrators as read-only by default. runbook snippet to pin: ```0m: partner posts
5m: liaison page oncall
10m: create bridge if no ack
15m: assign liaison owner
30m: consider model fallback or routing change```
bridge-bot: Bridge template created: https://internal/bridges/partner-quick-fallback. Calendar dry-run scheduled for 2770005000.
niya_partnerships: i'll share draft consent language and a partner-facing checklist. keeping it compact to reduce noise.
